visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short hair and glasses, wearing a professional white medical lab coat, sits at a red-topped desk in an office environment. She holds a black stylus in her right hand and gestures expressively with her left hand while looking toward two computer monitors. One monitor displays a technical document, while the other shows a circular blurred image of a face. A red water bottle and stacked papers are visible on the desk surface against a neutral wooden wall background. (2) The scene transitions to a medical procedure room where a male professional wearing a purple face mask and dark laser goggles operates a handheld BBL laser device. He moves the white applicator across the cheek of a patient lying down, while a purple-clad assistant monitors the procedure in the background. The device emits bright pink and white light flashes upon contact with the skin. (3) A highly detailed 3D digital animation displays the cross-section of human skin layers. Translucent blue spheres representing hyaluronic acid molecules float through the dermis layer. Yellow arrows and white text overlays point to specific pigment spots on a circular inset image of human skin to illustrate dermatological concepts. (4) The final phase is a static graphic information card with a grey and white textured background. It features the clinic's logo at the top and provides social media handles, a phone number, and physical addresses in black and blue Chinese typography. No human figures are present in this concluding scene.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A professional female speaker begins the audio track with a clear, authoritative, and friendly Mandarin narrative. She uses a moderate conversational pace with precise articulation. The background music is an upbeat electronic EDM track with a prominent synthesized drum machine rhythm and repeating melodic synth lines. The overall acoustic environment is very clean with high fidelity and studio-grade noise isolation. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks a transition in the speech as the narrator begins listing specific medical treatments. The BGM maintains its steady tempo but drops slightly in volume to prioritize the vocal clarity. Minimal incidental noise from the medical environment is heard as muffled background textures. (3) During the animation sequence, rhythmic 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects are introduced, synchronized with the movement of molecules on screen. These effects have a bright spectral quality and short duration. The speaker’s pitch remains stable with natural rising intonations used to emphasize key medical benefits. (4) The audio concludes with a final digital stinger SFX and a gradual fade-out of the electronic BGM. The speaker's closing remarks maintain the same professional and welcoming tone without any vocal strain or distortion artifacts.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem Identification -> Treatment Options -> Scientific Principle Explanation -> Contact CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational and promotional tool for DRX Dermatology Clinic. It explains the differences between skin conditions like freckles and sunspots, introduces advanced medical treatments like BBL and ruby lasers, and clarifies the scientific mechanism of water-light needles and hyaluronic acid to build trust and encourage bookings.
